explanation_formal: Σ⁰ and Λ are both uds, so no flavour changes and a photon carries off the 77 MeV difference: electromagnetic. The strong alternative, Σ⁰ → Λπ⁰, is closed because it would need 1250.7 MeV and the Σ⁰ has only 1192.6. The lifetime, 7.4 × 10⁻²⁰ s, sits in the electromagnetic band.
explanation_intuitive: The quarks stay the same; they just rearrange into a lower-energy state and shed the difference as light. A pion would be cheaper to make in principle, but the Σ⁰ can’t afford one.
explanation_steps: Quark content: Σ⁰ = uds, Λ = uds. S stays −1, so no weak decay is needed.
Charge, baryon number and lepton number all balance; one half-integer spin in and out.
A photon appears and no flavour changes, so the force is electromagnetic.
Could the strong force do it instead? Σ⁰ → Λπ⁰ needs 1115.68 + 134.98 = 1250.66 MeV, more than the Σ⁰’s mass. Closed.

explanation_formal: Strangeness changes from −1 to 0. Strong and electromagnetic interactions conserve strangeness, so only the weak interaction can do this. The Λ is the lightest strange baryon, so it has no strangeness-conserving way out. Its lifetime, 2.6 × 10⁻¹⁰ s, is in the weak band.
explanation_intuitive: The s quark has to turn into a u, and only the weak desk changes flavour. There’s no lighter strange baryon to step down to, so the Λ waits for the slow desk.
explanation_steps: Charge: 0 → +1 − 1 = 0. Baryon number 1 → 1. No leptons. Balances.
Strangeness: Λ (uds) has S = −1; p (uud) and π⁻ (dū) have S = 0. ΔS = 1.
A change in S means the force is weak (rule 2).
source: PDG 2026 masses and Λ lifetime; spec §6 golden case

explanation_formal: Only hadrons, every flavour number conserved, and about 154 MeV released: a strong decay. Its width of about 117 MeV corresponds to a lifetime ħ/Γ ≈ 5.6 × 10⁻²⁴ s.
explanation_intuitive: Nothing changes flavour, nothing but hadrons is involved, and there’s plenty of energy. The strong desk handles it almost instantly.
explanation_steps: Quarks: uuu → uud + ud̄. A d d̄ pair is created; the net flavour is unchanged.
Only hadrons and no flavour change: strong.
Lifetime from the width: 6.58 × 10⁻²² MeV·s ÷ 117 MeV ≈ 5.6 × 10⁻²⁴ s. Strong band.
source: PDG 2026 Δ(1232) mass and width estimates
